Buying both AMD and ANET would put 40% of the account in two correlated AI-infrastructure names; taking only one halves that. I chose to keep ANET (tighter exit, insider sales were under a pre-set plan, BNP upgrade) and skip AMD. This is a discretionary call that Portfolio A does not make: A buys AMD at the open, so the cost or benefit of this decision will be measured directly.
